legacy_cells.B: From assistance to autonomy: AI agent systems in cardiovascular medicine—a review of paradigms architectures and clinical translation
legacy_cells.C: Ye Chen, Xiaoqun Qin, Shouping Chen
legacy_cells.I: 014_2026_From assistance to autonomy AI agent systems in cardiovascular medicine—a review of paradigms architectures and clinical translation.pdf
legacy_cells.S: What current AI-agent paradigms, architectures, cardiovascular applications, and governance approaches are reported, and what evidence supports clinical translation?
legacy_cells.FM: Narrative synthesis of cardiovascular AI agent paradigms, architectures, clinical applications, and governance for clinical translation.
legacy_cells.FN: The review reports a cited rapid review of 13 studies (22,641 participants): 85% reported improved cardiovascular outcomes, mortality reductions of 0.8%–12%, and major adverse cardiovascular event reductions of 4%–12%.
legacy_cells.FO: The authors report field-level limitations: most evidence is retrospective with limited prospective validation; digital-twin studies have limited external validation, and face data-quality, computational, real-time, workflow-integration, and usability barriers.
legacy_cells.FP: The authors call for prospective real-world trials and integration of digital twins with multi-agent systems, alongside work on human–AI collaboration, governance, open-source models, and equity assessment.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify a lack of comprehensive synthesis focused on the shift toward autonomous cardiovascular agents, their architectures, and governance for clinical translation.
legacy_cells.FR: This is a narrative review, not a new implementation or evaluation of an integrated world model. Its agentic-system and digital-twin claims synthesize cited work and proposed architectures; the review does not demonstrate one end-to-end perception–dynamics–planning system or prospective clinical benefit.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M9 Safety & governance; M10 Clinician interface & lifecycle
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Carry the paper’s governance and evaluation considerations into a separate safety/lifecycle service; they do not validate a dynamics model.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Prospective evaluation & lifecycle governance
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–14: title and abstract, Introduction and review methods, Sections 2–4 and Tables 1–4, Discussion §§5.1–5.4, and Conclusion; examined relevant end matter on pp. 15–16. No unreadable relevant tables or extraction problems noted. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A–I were preserved except B, whose punctuation differs from the printed title. The quantitative findings are the review’s summary of cited studies, not original experiments by this paper. Capability and readiness were not assigned to avoid attributing reviewed systems’ results to the review itself. Evidence QA: 8/15 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (53.3%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 18 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All 16 physical pages read including 52 references/end matter. All pages rendered; figures 1–2/tables1–4 inspected on pages4,6,7,11,12. No included appendix.
Cited systems, metrics, clinical outcomes and regulatory claims not independently verified; no original empirical model or clinical evaluation.
Publisher Systematic Review tag differs from narrative methods; no reproducible screening/PRISMA procedure presented.
Page15 AI drafting acknowledgments conflict with generative AI non-use statement.
Single-model source review and skeptical reread, no independent human review or replication.
notes: No readiness facet assigned to a survey. No WM world type inferred from topical cardiovascular coverage. Figure2 is conceptual synthesis, not implemented interface evidence. Article CC BY is not code/data/weights license.
